# PKM Migration - Overview

**Project Goal**: Migrate garthschwer.com from Obsidian Publish/Sync to a GitHub-hosted Quartz 4 site.

---

## Context
This project aims to reduce subscription overhead and gain more control over the digital garden's technical stack using Quartz 4, GitHub Actions, and Bun.

## Relationships
- **Parent Goal**: [[PKM Migration]] (Global TELOS)
- **Status**: Initializing

## Tech Stack
- **Site Generator**: [Quartz 4](https://quartz.jzhao.xyz/)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Runtime**: Bun
- **Hosting**: GitHub Pages
- **Sync**: Obsidian Git Plugin
